'''Arts and culture'''
*Officials announce that the [[Gathering of Nations]] event in [[Albuquerque]], [[New Mexico]], [[United States]], will host its final [[pow-wow]] in 2026. [https://apnews.com/article/gathering-of-nations-powwow-indigenous-native-american-f9d69ff3b3a62d08f7f2116aa5465c61 (AP)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2025 Air Canada flight attendants strike]]
**[[Air Canada]] suspends its plan to resume flights after cabin crew continued a strike despite a [[Canada Industrial Relations Board]] order and government-imposed arbitration, leaving operations halted and affecting more than 700 flights and about 130,000 daily passengers. [https://business.inquirer.net/541817/air-canada-suspends-plan-to-resume-flights (''Philippine Daily Inquirer'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Sulawesi earthquake]]
**One person is killed and 29 people are injured when a {{M|w|5.8}} [[undersea earthquake]] strikes near [[Poso]], [[Central Sulawesi]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://apnews.com/article/indonesia-earthquake-poso-sulawesi-c495c225c29d5862c91fba6f311718e9 (AP)] [https://radarpalu.jawapos.com/sulteng/2606447113/satu-korban-gempa-poso-meninggal-dunia-diumumkan-pemerintah-desa-masani-lewat-pengeras-suara (''Jawa Pos'')]
*More than 40 people are reported missing and ten others are rescued when a boat carrying 50 people to a popular market [[Capsizing|capsizes]] on the [[Sokoto River]] near [[Goronyo]], [[Sokoto State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/more-than-40-missing-nigeria-boat-accident-emergency-agency-says-2025-08-17/ (Reuters)] [https://apnews.com/article/nigeria-boat-accident-goronyo-missing-01cfdf27815f5e13984288ebec310b40 (AP)]
*At least seven people are killed and five others are injured when a [[cloudburst]] causes [[flash flood]]ing and [[landslide]]s in [[Kathua district]], [[Jammu and Kashmir (union territory)|Jammu and Kashmir]], [[India]]. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-news/another-cloudburst-in-j-k-4-killed-in-kathua-101755401937851.html (''Hindustan Times'')] [https://www.dailyexcelsior.com/cloudburst-landslide-in-jammu-and-kashmirs-kathua-leaves-seven-dead/ (''Daily Excelsior'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2025 Crown Heights nightclub shooting]]
**Three people are killed and nine others are injured in a [[Mass shootings in the United States|mass shooting]] at a nightclub in the [[Crown Heights]] neighborhood of [[New York City]], [[United States]]. [https://www.startribune.com/three-killed-eight-injured-in-shooting-in-crowded-new-york-club-amid-record-low-gun-violence-year/601456442 (''Minnesota Star Tribune'')]
*[[Ecuadorian conflict (2024–present)|Ecuadorian conflict]]
**At least seven people are killed in a [[mass shooting]] at a [[billiard hall]] in [[Santo Domingo, Ecuador|Santo Domingo]], [[Ecuador]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20250817-seven-killed-in-latest-ecuador-pool-hall-shooting (France 24)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Gaza war hostage crisis]]
***[[Israeli hostage deal protests]]
****A [[general strike]] and mass protests calling for a hostage deal and ceasefire to end the Gaza war occur across [[Israel]], involving approximately 2.5 million protesters across the country and 300,000 at the protest held in [[Hostages Square]], [[Tel Aviv]]. At least 32 protesters are arrested. [https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/2025-08-17/ty-article-live/netanyahu-says-he-would-agree-only-to-an-all-in-one-hostage-deal-all-our-conditions/00000198-b5a5-d4ef-a399-ffe77a6a0000?liveBlogItemId=1726059672#1726059672 (''Haaretz'')] [https://www.cbsnews.com/amp/news/protesters-israel-nationwide-strike-demand-ceasefire-release-hostages-gaza/ (CBS News)]
*[[2025 Bolivian general election]]
**[[Bolivians]] vote to elect a [[President of Bolivia|president]], [[Vice President of Bolivia|vice president]], 130 members of the [[Chamber of Deputies (Bolivia)|Chamber of Deputies]], and 36 members of the [[Chamber of Senators (Bolivia)|Chamber of Senators]]. Preliminary results indicate a [[Run-off election|run-off]] between Senator [[Rodrigo Paz Pereira]] and former president [[Jorge Quiroga]], ending the [[Movimiento al Socialismo]]'s 20-year [[Politics of Bolivia|political dominance]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/bolivia-votes-support-left-wanes-inflation-is-top-mind-2025-08-17/ (Reuters)] [https://apnews.com/article/bolivia-elections-right-wing-274e22ad9f493f60669a01615d3fef65 (AP)]

'''Sports'''
*[[Horse racing in Great Britain]]
**The [[British Horseracing Authority]] announces a one-day strike on September 10 to protest a proposed increase in [[betting on horse racing|betting]] taxes from 15% to 21%. This is the first time the sport has ever voluntarily refused to race in modern history. [https://apnews.com/article/british-horseracing-strike-99b0c5066f5a572afdb142a498f3e0b8 (AP)] [https://www.bbc.com/sport/horse-racing/articles/c741xyn558ko (BBC Sport)]
